title: Anskaffelse av rammeavtaler for IT-konsulenter
description: Fiskeridirektoratet ønsker å inngå rammeavtaler for IT-konsulenter innenfor 5 ulike kompetanseområder/kategorier. Vi vil leie inn ønskede ressurser ved behov tilknyttet digitalisering. Det skal inngås flere parallelle rammeavtaler innenfor hvert enkelt av de 5 kompetanseområdene listet opp nedenfor. Tilbyderne som best tilfredsstiller kravene som stilles i kravspesifikasjonen innenfor de ulike kompetanseområdene, blir tildelt kontrakter innenfor det/de enkelte kompetanseområde(ne) der tilbyderen er best kvalifisert. Tilbyder kan levere tilbud i én, flere eller alle kategoriene. Tildeling av rammeavtaler innenfor hvert enkelt kompetanseområde foretas uavhengig av hverandre. Én tilbyder kan dermed bli tildelt flere av de aktuelle rammeavtalene, og for hvert kompetanseområde vil Fiskeridirektoratet tildele rammeavtaler til de 3 beste tilbyderne. For hele anskaffelsen skal det dermed inngås 15 avtaler totalt. Fiskeridirektoratet vil gjennomføre avrop i form av minikonkurranser mellom leverandørene med rammeavtale innenfor det enkelte kompetanseområdet, for å finne den eller de best egnede ressursene for å dekke behovet. Konsulenttjenestene er delt inn i følgende 5 kompetanseområder: 1. Systemutvikling og teknisk testing 2. Teknisk prosjektledelse innen digitalisering og digital transformasjon 3. Dataplattform og informasjonsforvaltning 4. Drift av digital plattform (DevOps/SRE) 5. Lokal drift / skydrift Tjenesten leveres ved at konsulenter innlemmes i våre allerede eksisterende team som har ansvar for både utvikling og drift/monitorering, og bidrar der med sin kompetanse og kapasitet. Rammeavtalene skal i utgangspunktet gjelde fra ca. 10.03.2027 og vil ha en varighet på 1 år, med opsjon på 1+1+1 års forlengelse av avtalene. Anslått totalverdi for hele anskaffelsen er på 250 millioner NOK eks. mva. Behov og verdi vil imidlertid variere innenfor de ulike kompetanseområdene. Se konkurransedokumenter for mer informasjon.

title: Offentligt udbud vedr. flytteydelser
description: NEXT Uddannelse København udbyder rammeaftale på flytteydelser. NEXT Uddannelse København er ansvarlig for udbuddets gennemførelse og varetager således den løbende kommunikation med tilbudsgiverne. Rammeaftalen vedrører Ordregivers indkøb af Flytteydelser hos Leverandøren. Flytteydelser omfatter flytning af inventar indenfor eller mellem Ordregivers bygninger samt til Ordregivers forskellige lokationer i Storkøbenhavn. Flytteopgaven omfatter rådgivning, planlægning, vejledning, afhentning af flyttegodset, kørsel samt løs anbringelse af flyttegodset efter Ordregivers anvisning på den nye plads. Ordregiver kan bestille Flytteydelser og hertil knyttede ydelser hos Leverandøren på de i denne Rammeaftales angivne betingelser og vilkår. Der henvises til kravspecifikationen i Bilag 1 for en nærmere beskrivelse af det udbudte, herunder fastsatte mindstekrav. Endvidere henvises til tilbudslisten i Bilag 2, som Tilbudsgiver skal udfylde. Desuden henvises til udkast til rammeaftale i Bilag 3. Ordregiver er forpligtet til at anvende rammeaftalen. Forpligtelsen medfører dog ikke en pligt for Ordregiver til at aftage en bestemt mængde af de ydelser, der er omfattet af rammeaftalen. Kendte flytteopgaver i aftaleperioden: Ordregiver skal forventeligt fraflytte lokationerne Tæbyvej 65, Rødovre, Fabriksparken 31, Glostrup og Marielundvej 44, Herlev og flytter størstedelen af aktiviteten på disse lokationer til Ordregivers nye lokation, Hovedstadens Håndværkercampus, Langagervej 60, Glostrup. Flytningen foregår forventeligt i etaper i årene 2027 og 2028. Derudover forventer Ordregiver at fraflytte lokationen Rentemestervej 17, København NV i løbet af 2028 til Rebslagervej 11, København NV. title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Sanierung der Einfeld-Schulsporthalle an der Realschule Plus in Cochem - Los 01
description: Der Landkreis Cochem-Zell plant die umfassende Sanierung der Einfeld-Schulsporthalle an der Realschule Plus in Cochem. Die Realschule Plus in Cochem ist zusammen mit dem angrenzenden Gymnasium Teil des Schulzentrums in Cochem im Burgsattel. Das im Jahr 1967 errichtete Gebäude wurde bislang nur teilweise saniert. Aufgrund des erheblichen Sanierungsbedarfs an Fassade, Dach, Sportböden sowie Umkleiden und WC-Anlagen ist eine grundlegende bauliche und technische Erneuerung erforderlich. Die erforderlichen Sanierungsleistungen sind der Projektbeschreibung Hallensanierung (siehe Anlage C - vorhandene Planungsgrundlagen) zu entnehmen. Aufgrund des Baujahres ist die Maßnahme zudem unter Berücksichtigung möglicher Schadstoffbelastungen durchzuführen. Für einzelne Bauteile wurden bereits Untersuchungen vorgenommen. Dabei wurden PCP-haltige Holzwerkstoffplatten in der Gymnastikhalle festgestellt. Darüber hinaus sind mögliche PAK-Belastungen der Dachabdichtung sowie schadstoffhaltige künstliche Mineralfasern zu berücksichtigen. Die untersuchten PVC-Bodenbeläge und Klebstoffe wurden als asbestfrei eingestuft. Weitere Untersuchungen sind im Zuge der Planung und bei Bedarf während der Bauausführung erforderlich. Die Finanzierung der Sanierung soll mit Unterstützung von Fördermitteln aus dem Sondervermögen Infrastruktur erfolgen. Hierfür sind im Rahmen der Planung die erforderlichen Förderunterlagen, insbesondere eine umfassende Baubeschreibung, Planunterlagen und Kostenberechnungen, zu erstellen. Ziel der Maßnahme ist die nachhaltige bauliche, energetische und technische Modernisierung der Schulsporthalle, die Verbesserung der Nutzungs- und Aufenthaltsqualität sowie die langfristige Sicherstellung eines zeitgemäßen und sicheren Sportbetriebs. Einzelheiten zu vertraglichen Fristen entnehmen Sie bitte dem beigefügten Architektenvertrag.

title: J041--TIERED EVALUATION: Preventive Maintenance and Repair Services for HVAC Water Chillers and Air Handling Units (AHU) at the VA Caribbean Healthcare System (VACHS)
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 12.201-1, Simplified procedures. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested, and a written solicitation document will not be issued. The Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office (NCO) 8, located at VA Caribbean Healthcare System (VACHS), is seeking to award a single firm-fixed-price requirements type contract for Preventive Maintenance and Repair Services for HVAC Water Chillers and Air Handling Units (AHUs) at the VA Caribbean Healthcare System (VACHS) . This solicitation is issued as an RFQ. The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2026-01, effective on March 13, 2026 (and as supplemented by VA Deviations). TIERED EVALUATION. This solicitation will be evaluated using a tiered evaluation approach (also known as cascading set asides). The tiers for this procurement are: 1st Tier- Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) 2nd Tier- Small Business Evaluation will begin with the first tier. If the Government receives two or more acceptable quotes from the first tier, the evaluation will not proceed to the next tier. If fewer than two acceptable quotes are received at a given tier, the Government may proceed to evaluate the next tier. The associated North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 238220, Plumbing, Heating, and Air Conditioning Contractors. The applicable small business size standard is $19,000,000. The Product Service Code (PSC) is J041, Maintenance, Repair, and Rebuilding of Equipment - Refrigeration, Air Conditioning, and Air Circulating Equipment. Detailed specifications and requirements are provided in the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS), Instructions to Quoters, Price/Cost Schedule, Clauses, and Provisions. The resulting contract will include a five-year ordering period. In addition, RFO Clause 52.217-8, Option to Extend Services, is included in the RFQ. Place of Performance San Juan Address: VA Caribbean Healthcare System 10 Casia St. San Juan, PR The full text of the RFO provisions or clauses may be accessed electronically at https://www.acquisition.gov/far-overhaul. The following solicitation provisions apply to this acquisition: RFO 52.212-1, Instructions to Offerors Commercial Products and Commercial Services. , [Sep 2023] [Deviation Nov 2025), including an addendum to this provision. Offerors shall carefully read the addendum, which provides further information regarding this requirement and the minimum information/documentation that shall be submitted with the quote. Offerors must complete annual representations and certifications electronically via the System for Award Management (SAM) website located at https://www.sam.gov/portal. The following contract clauses apply to this requirement: RFO 52.212-4, Contract Terms and Conditions Commercial Products and Commercial Services [Nov 2023] [Deviation Nov 2025](Addendum attached). See clauses in the attached document titled "S02 Attachments B_C_D_E RFQ 36C24826Q0366_PM Chillers and AHUs_25 June 2026 The contract award will be based upon a comparative evaluation of quotes in accordance with the evaluation process outlined in the RFO 12.203(c)(2). Comparative evaluation is the side by side pairwise comparison of quotes based on factors resulting in a Contracting Officer decision for the quote most favorable to the Government. To facilitate the award process, all quotes must include a statement regarding the terms and conditions herein as follows: "The terms and conditions in the solicitation are acceptable to be included in the award document without modification, deletion, or addition." OR "The terms and conditions in the solicitation are acceptable to be included in the award document with the exception, deletion, or addition of the following:" Quoters shall list exception(s) and rationale for the exception(s), if any. SITE VISIT. A site visit has been scheduled for December 1, 2026, at 10:00 AM. The meeting point will be at the VA San Juan Medical Center main entrance, next to the Police Station. Vendors interested in participating in the site visit shall send an email to Baryan Sierra at baryan.sierrapierluissi@va.gov with the participant names (maximum 2 per company). QUESTIONS SUBMISSION. Questions regarding this acquisition shall be emailed to the Contracting Officer, Baryan Sierra, at baryan.sierrapierluissi@va.gov. All questions shall be submitted as a Word document. All questions are due on December 7, 2026, at 10:00 AM (Puerto Rico Local Time). Questions submitted after the due date may not be considered by the Government. The Quote shall be received no later than January 12, 2027, at 10:00 AM (Puerto Rico Local Time) to Baryan Sierra at baryan.sierrapierluissi@va.gov. title: Helmet-Mounted First-Person View Display System
description: I. Description USSOCOM is conducting market research to identify sources capable of providing dismounted Special Operations Forces with a helmet-mounted first-person view (FPV) display. This display must deliver an expanded field of view, certified ballistic protection, real-time tactical information overlay, and unmanned system control in contested, congested, and all-weather environments. The effort aims to develop a 50-degree field-of-view Display Module that integrates full military ballistic protection, ATAK capability, head tracking, improved display performance, and expanded environmental durability while remaining compatible with existing soldier systems and helmets. This announcement is for market research purposes only and is not a solicitation. The Government will use responses to this notice to assess interest and capability within the industry and to determine the acquisition strategy (e.g., limited competition or small business set-aside). This Sources Sought is posted as a Call to Vulcan and all responses must be submitted to Vulcan. II. Requested Information Interested vendors are requested to submit the following information: Company Information: Company name, address, point of contact, CAGE code, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), CMMC/NIST (type, date, score), website. Business Size: Indicate your business size and socio-economic status (e.g., small business, 8(a), HUBZone, etc.). Confirm your business size relative to 541715 � Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology). Security Clearance: Indicate your current facility clearance and the level of facility security clearances you can maintain. Relevant Experience: Provide a brief overview of your experience in supporting SOF, system testing, commercial integration, and ATAK areas as listed below. If no experience, briefly identify the names and CAGE codes of any small businesses that have demonstrated experience that your company can team/partner with on this requirement. Display Systems. System testing (researching, planning, designing, developing, analyzing, and testing a variety of electronic equipment and systems, military command, control, communications, computers, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (C5ISR) systems, interface units, and other electronic devices and test equipment) to support enhanced situational awareness, command and control, and precision effects while retaining mobility, protection, and compatibility with existing soldier equipment. Experience with existing soldier equipment (ATAK EUD, radios, hubs). Experience with researching, testing, and integrating emerging technologies as they pertain to real-time overlay of ATAK tactical data, targeting information, and UAS video/control in day, night, and all-weather contested environments. Capability Statement: Submit a capability statement that responds to the following questions: Describe your company�s relevant experience providing SOF support in any of the following areas: ATAK interface, ballistic protection integration, development testing, head tracking sensor integration, software updates and integration, integrating processing hardware and the Display Module into a single module, Windblast compatibility, Expanded environmental envelope, similar requirements or related mission sets. Include contract numbers, customers, and scope. Explain your approach to development milestones (SRR, PDR, CDR, development tests, prototype deliveries) for the combined work scope versus individual items and identify any related any similar efforts. Confirm your company�s ability to maintain adherence to milestones and react to shifts within technology or supply chains to avoid impact to development and enable future scaling of production. Describe your recruiting, screening, and retention strategy for specialized Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Explain how your company would manage and execute a contract for this development. What program management tools, structures, or practices will ensure successful delivery? Describe your Quality Assurance/Quality Control processes and how they would ensure compliance with the Statement of Objectives (SOO), Key Performance Parameters (KPPs) and Key System Attributes (KSAs). If applicable, identify any suppliers, subcontractors or teaming partners. Specify their roles and the percentage of work they are expected to perform. Identify any services within the SOO that meet the definition of commercial services under FAR 2.101. Provide catalog pricing or related contract references. Provide feedback on a recommendation on contract type and structure (length, phases, single award, FFP/CPFF, OTA). Are there any risks or constraints that may affect your participation? Identify how the USSOCOM can best structure these contract requirements to facilitate competition by and among small business concerns. Identify any condition or action that may be having the effect of unnecessarily restricting competition with respect to this acquisition. Provide the specific aspects that unreasonably restrict competition and the rationale for such conclusion. Recommendations to improve the approach/specifications/NAICS/PSC/ DRAFT SOO to acquiring the identified items/services. III. Submission Details Submission Deadline: 3:00 Eastern on 01-DEC-2026 Submission Location: All submissions shall be made within https://vulcan-sof.com/ Submit To: https://vulcan-sof.com/login/ng2/submission?collectionUuid=a26a99ef-c351-464f-af93-dbcc064df521 IV. Disclaimer This Sources Sought is issued solely for informational and planning purposes and does not constitute a Request for Proposal. Responses will not be returned, and the Government will not reimburse costs incurred in response preparation. Participation in this notice is not a guarantee of future contract award.

title: Virtual Industry Day for FY27 USACE Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center National Small Business MATOC
description: Virtual Industry Day for FY27 USACE Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center National Small Business MATOC The Virtual Industry Day Meeting for the USACE Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center National Small Business MATOC will occur on 12 January 2027 from 1300ET to 16:00ET via Teams. All interested dredging companies are encouraged to attend. If you would like to provide comments or questions prior to the Industry day, please do so on wwww.projnet.org. All questions or comments are due by 04 January 2027 at 1100 ET. Solicitation Number: W912PM27RA007 Bidder Inquiry Key: PV63ES-IJ49PU National Small Business Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC): The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) executes construction contracts for regular, reoccurring, and emergency National Enterprise Dredging requirements at various coastal harbors, inland rivers, canals, and connecting channels throughout the United States. Individual projects are typically annual requirements and may utilize mechanical, hydraulic, or a combination of dredging equipment and techniques with activities to include but not limited to maintenance and new work dredging, dredged material placement, and other activities such as Confined Disposal Facility (CDF), Dredged Material Disposal Facility (DMDF), or upland placement site maintenance, groundskeeping, other earthwork at placement sites, surveying, or other work connected with dredging and placement requirements. Task orders issued under this MATOC will require the contractor to mobilize dredge plant and support vessels to the project location, perform dredging as shown on the respective plan(s), place dredged material�which may include beach nourishment, open-water placement, CDFs, DMDFs, beneficial use, or alternative placement strategies as indicated in individual task orders�, provide for any necessary environmental required protected species observers (PSOs) or environmental surveys, and demobilize once complete. The maximum ordering capacity for the 5-year ordering period of the MATOC and maximum task order amounts are TBD. Below are the draft source selection criteria proposed: FACTOR 1: Technical Capability a. Submission Requirements: Dredge Information: The offeror shall provide documentation for any dredges being proposed for use under this solicitation/contract, and any subsequent task orders. If the proposal does not include at least one of the identified dredges below, then Factor 1 will be rated �Unacceptable�. Proposed dredges must include a minimum of at least one of the following: Cutter Suction Dredge - employs a mechanical cutter to break up material which is then excavated hydraulically and transported to the placement site through a pipeline. Minimum Requirement: 10-inch discharge diameter or larger Mechanical Dredge - uses of some form of bucket to excavate and raise submerged material. Minimum Requirement: 5 cubic yard bucket or larger Offeror can submit more than one dredge(s) that meets the minimum requirements above in responding to this evaluation factor. Dredges that are still under construction or are in the process of undergoing major reconstruction will not be considered. The dredge documentation must include the following information: dredge type; certify that the dredge meets minimum requirements stated above; proof offeror owns the dredges submitted (leased dredges are not acceptable). FACTOR 2: Past Performance Submission Requirements: Offerors will be required to provide three (3) past performance examples of recent and relevant maintenance dredging projects for the type of dredge submitted under Factor 1 � Technical Capability, which demonstrate that they have experience accomplishing the following: dredging of Navigation Channels, Rivers, Harbors, Inland Waterways with depths ranging from 6 feet to 50 feet. The past performance examples must include dredging that has been performed within the last six (6) years from the date of the solicitation. In addition to submitted examples, the Government may review any other sources of information for evaluation of past performance. If the Offeror is proposing as a Joint Venture (JV), Partnership and/or Teaming Arrangement and past performance cannot be provided as such, each partner shall submit past performance information but shall not exceed the three (3) projects total for this factor. Note 1: NAA: The Offeror will be required to provide documentation related to EM 385-1-1 requirements such as Floating Service Naval Architecture Analysis (NAA) with either MATOC or Task Order proposal. 2. Note 2: The Offeror may be required to submit a letter of commitment with their proposal from a surety that confirms that the offeror's bonding capacity meets a specified minimum amount. Please RSVP no later than 9AM ET 11 January 2027 to both Ros Shoemaker and Elizabeth (Lisa) Trimble at Rosalind.m.shoemaker@usace.army.mil and Elizabeth.M.Trimble@usace.army.mil if you plan to attend the Industry Day. A Teams calendar invite will be sent out to all RSVP�s.

buyer: Inspection fédérale de la sécurité nucléaire IFSN
title: (26163) 998 Partenaire technique WEB
description:
L'Inspection fédérale de la sécurité nucléaire (IFSN) est tenue de fournir des informations au public et aux autorités. Le site web de l'IFSN met à la disposition du public toutes les informations pertinentes et comprend une rubrique « Actualités » ainsi que des contenus statiques tels que des pages, des documents et le Forum technique.


Le site web respecte les directives de la Confédération en matière d’identité visuelle (CI) et de conception (CD) et est multilingue (allemand, français, italien et anglais). Des contenus sont également disponibles en « langue simplifiée » et en « langue des signes ».


L’IFSN exploite les trois sites web ENSI, ENSI-RAT et EGT-Suisse sur une base technique uniforme avec une configuration WordPress multisite, un design cohérent, des plugins spécifiques à l’IFSN et des interfaces vers des systèmes externes. L’infrastructure d’hébergement, dotée de différents environnements de développement, garantit un fonctionnement sécurisé.


L’appel d’offres a pour objectif le changement de partenaire technique et d’hébergement, ainsi que la mise en place d’un « darksite » autonome pouvant être activé en cas d’urgence ou de crise.


Nous recherchons un partenaire technique chargé de l’exploitation sécurisée, de la maintenance et du développement de l’infrastructure technique. Cela comprend la gestion des sites web existants, la migration vers un partenaire d’hébergement adapté, ainsi que la gestion de projet et la mise en œuvre du « darksite ».

title: Germany – Electrical services – Ingenieurleistungen nach Teil 4 Abschnitt 2 HOAI (Technische Ausrüstung)
description: 68163 Mannheim, Paul-Wittsack-Str. 6, Geb. G alt, MA, HS, Gebäude G (alt), Gesamtsanierung, Ingenieurleistungen nach Teil 4 Abschnitt 2 HOAI (Technische Ausrüstung). Das Land Baden-Württemberg, vertreten durch Vermögen und Bau Baden-Württemberg, beabsichtigt die Generalsanierung des Gebäudes G (Altbau) der Technischen Hochschule Mannheim. Gegenstand dieses Auftrags sind Fachplanungsleistungen der Technischen Ausrüstung nach Teil 4 Abschnitt 2 HOAI für die Anlagengruppen nach § 53 Abs. 2 Nr. 4 und 5 HOAI, Grundleistungen der Leistungsphasen 1 bis 3 und 5 bis 9 sowie Besondere Leistungen der Leistungsphasen 5, 8 und 9. Das Gebäude G (Altbau) der Technischen Hochschule Mannheim wurde in den Jahren 1970 bis 1972 errichtet und dient als Labor- und Hörsaalgebäude. Aufgrund der langen Nutzungszeit von über 50 Jahren entspricht das Gebäude in baulicher, brandschutztechnischer und haustechnischer Hinsicht nicht mehr dem heutigen Stand der Technik, daher soll es generalsaniert werden. Es handelt sich um einen zweigeschossigen Stahlbetonskelettbau mit Untergeschoss und einer Nutzfläche von 1.473 m². Es beinhaltet bisher auf beiden Geschossen Laborbereiche (Kategorie S1) mit einer großen Anzahl von Digestorien und einen sich über das UG und EG erstreckenden innenliegenden Hörsaal mit ansteigendem Gestühl, im Bestand derzeit ohne natürliche Belichtung. Das Gebäude hat eine Grundfläche von 26,10m x 39,90m. Die Flächen der Generalsanierung belaufen sich auf 1.473 m² NUF R, die Gesamtfläche mit Verkehrs- und Technikflächen beläuft sich auf 2.929 m² NRF. Moderne Lernformen sind bei der Neukonzeption zu berücksichtigen und zu ermöglichen, etwa Lernflächen in den Flurzonen oder Projektgruppen-Arbeitsräume. Bisher fehlende Funktionsräume wie z. B. Umkleiden für die Labore oder barrierefreie WC-Anlagen sind zu ergänzen. Die geschätzten Bauwerkskosten sind ca. 19,3 Mio. €, für die KG 300 wird von 8,1 Mio. € und für die KG 400 von 11,2 Mio. € ausgegangen. Der Baubeginn ist für Ende 2030 geplant, die Baufertigstellung für Ende 2033.

description: Europese Openbare aanbesteding Raamovereenkomst Afrasteringen Aanleiding voor deze aanbestedingsprocedure is het van rechtswege aflopen per 1 februari 2027 van de huidige Raamovereenkomsten. WSRL is voornemens nieuwe Raamovereenkomsten aan te gaan. In onderstaande opsomming worden de afrasteringen nader gespecificeerd evenals de geschatte volumes per jaar. Specificatie afrasteringen en geschatte volumes per jaar: Raster herstelwerk Schapengaas zware Ursus (of gelijkwaardig) met betonnen palen - 500 meter Schapengaas zware Ursus (of gelijkwaardig) met houten palen - 1500 meter Puntdraad met betonnen palen - 500 meter Puntdraad met houten palen - 500 meter Raster nieuw te plaatsen Schapengaas zware Ursus (of gelijkwaardig) met houten palen - 5000 meter Puntdraad met houten palen - 1000 meter Gladde draad met houten palen - 500 meter Aan bovenstaande genoemde volumes kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Tijdens de duur van de Raamovereenkomst kan de soort afrastering worden aangevuld of gewijzigd. De opgave zoals hier is vermeld is niet limitatief. Bijkomende kleine werkzaamheden gerelateerd aan het plaatsen en of herstellen van afrasteringen maken deel uit van deze raamovereenkomst. Dit betreft dan o.a. het plaatsen van klaphekjes en of het maken van overstapjes. De levering en onderhoud van stalen hekwerken (toegangshekken) valt buiten de scope van deze aanbesteding. Looptijd De Raamovereenkomst gaat in op 1 februari 2027 en loopt tot en met 31 januari 2029. Na afloop van deze looptijd kan de Raamovereenkomst, onder gelijkblijvende voorwaarden, tweemaal met één jaar worden verlengd. De totale contractduur bedraagt daarmee 4 jaar.

title: Netherlands – Payroll management services – Dienstverleningsovereenkomst salarisadministratie
description: Europese aanbesteding voor een dienstverleningsovereenkomst salarisadministratie. Waterschap Rivierenland (WSRL) streeft naar een toekomstbestendige, kwalitatief hoogwaardige en robuuste inrichting van de salarisadministratie. Om deze reden wenst WSRL de salarisadministratie structureel onder te brengen bij een professionele en deskundige externe partner die de operationele uitvoering integraal verzorgt. De opdrachtnemer treedt hierbij op als inhoudelijk expert en adviseur en waarborgt de continuïteit, kwaliteit en rechtmatigheid van de salarisverwerking. De gewenste situatie is een duurzame samenwerking waarin de opdrachtnemer verantwoordelijk is voor de volledige salarisadministratie van WSRL gedurende de gehele contractperiode. De dienstverlening wordt uitgevoerd conform de geldende wet- en regelgeving, de Cao Waterschappen, ABP-regelingen en de binnen WSRL geldende arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken. Daarnaast wordt van de opdrachtnemer verwacht dat deze actief meedenkt over optimalisatie, standaardisatie en verdere digitalisering van salaris- en HR-processen. De dienstverlening dient zodanig te zijn ingericht dat continuïteit te allen tijde is gewaarborgd. Afhankelijkheid van individuele medewerkers moet worden voorkomen, kennis dient duurzaam te zijn geborgd en de salarisverwerking moet tijdig, correct en conform de overeengekomen kwaliteits- en servicenormen worden uitgevoerd. Binnen deze samenwerking behoudt WSRL een regie-, coördinatie- en accorderingsrol. De verantwoordelijkheid voor de operationele uitvoering en de vakinhoudelijke kwaliteit van de salarisadministratie ligt bij de opdrachtnemer. Waterschap Rivierenland wenst met één partij een dienstverleningsovereenkomst voor de salarisadministratie aan te gaan voor een periode van twee (2) jaar met een optionele verlenging van twee (2) x één (1) jaar. De Algemene waterschapsinkoopvoorwaarden voor diensten (AWVODI-2018) zijn van toepassing. Voorwaarden van de Inschrijver of andere algemene voorwaarden worden uitdrukkelijk van de hand gewezen. De Inschrijver dient zich volledig aan de door Waterschap Rivierenland gestelde voorwaarden te conformeren. Door het doen van een inschrijving gaat de Inschrijver daarmee akkoord.

title: Czechia – Construction work – Brno, Pekařská - rekonstrukce kanalizace a vodovodu
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je provedení rekonstrukce kanalizace a vodovodu, včetně kanalizačních a vodovodních přípojek, dále bude upraven celý veřejný prostor včetně modernizace tramvajové tratě, bude provedena kompletní obnova komunikací, parkovacích a odstavných stání, chodníků, včetně rekonstrukce veřejného osvětlení a trolejového vedení. Kanalizace a kanalizační přípojky: Kanalizace v ulici Pekařská pochází z let 1898 až 1901 a bude rekonstruována v celkové délce 680 m, z toho bezvýkopovou metodou (ve štole) v délce 146 m (v profilu DN 1000/1500 v délce 131 m a 500/750 v délce 15 m) a v otevřeném výkopu v délce 535 m (v profilu DN 1000/1500 délky 27 m, DN 800/1200 délky 430 m, DN 500/750 délky 61 m a DN 300 délky 16 m). Stávající kanalizace, které nebude při provádění stavebních prací vytěžena, bude zalita cementopopílkovou suspenzí. Zrekonstruovány budou rovněž všechny kanalizační přípojky ve veřejném prostranství o profilu DN 150 až DN 400 a v celkové délce 587,1 m a přípojky k dešťovým svodům v profilech KT DN 125 – DN 150 v celkové délce 279,5 m. Vodovod a vodovodní přípojky Bude provedena rekonstrukce vodovodu z tvárné litiny s těžkou protikorozní ochranou v celkové délce 881,7 m (v profilu DN 300 v délce 442 m, v profilu DN 250 v délce 269 m , v profilu DN 150 v dílce 170m). Po dobu stavby vodovodu bude náhradní zásobování vodou zajištěno prostřednictvím provizorního vodovodu z ocelových trub Ø 273x6,3 mm a délce 442 m a z ocelových trub Ø 219x8,0 mm v délce 269 m. V rámci stavby budou rekonstruovány vodovodní přípojky DN50, DN80 a DN100 v celkové délce 304,7 m. Hydrovrty V rámci stavby bude rekonstruovaná kanalizace v úseku Š953304 – Š7 a Š994565 – Š4 realizována za trvalého hloubkového odvodňování, a to soustavou hydrovrtů hl. 10 m a v počtu 29 ks. Rekonstrukce VO, přeložky sítí Součástí rekonstrukce ulice Pekařské je dále přeložka stávajícího veřejného osvětlení, dále přeložky sítí (CETIN, MU, Vodafone, T-mobile, FASTER, sdělovacích kabelů DPMB). Tramvajová trať Součástí stavby bude přeložka dvoukolejné tramvajové trati na velkoplošných železobetonových panelech s usazením žlábkové kolejnice NT1 a NT3, v úseku od křižovatky s ulicí Úvoz až po zastávku Šilingrovo náměstí. Součástí přeložky tramvajové trati je realizace 2 ks zastávek, 22 trakčních stožárů, přeložka trolejového vedení, kabelové sítě, přívodních kabelů ELP a přípojek NN pro ELP. Tramvajová trať bude realizována v celkové délce cca 653,50 m. Parametry pro obnovení kolejové dráhy musí plně respektovat vnitřní směrnice Dopravního podniku města Brna, a.s. (dále „DPMB“): • směrnice T07 „TECHNICKÉ PODMÍNKY PRO VÝSTAVBU, REKONSTRUKCE A ÚDRŽBU TRAKČNÍCH VEDENÍ DPMB“ v platném znění. • směrnice T08 „TECHNICKÉ PODMÍNKY PRO PROVOZ A ÚDRŽBU TRAMVAJOVÝCH TRATÍ DPMB“ v platném znění • směrnice T09 „TECHNICKÉ PODMÍNKY PRO VÝSTAVBU A REKONSTRUKCE TRAMVAJOVÝCH TRATÍ DPMB“ v platném znění. Tato směrnice stanovuje technické podmínky pro veškeré rekonstrukce a výstavbu nových tramvajových tratí, resp. kolejové konstrukce a křižovatky, které jsou ve vlastnictví DPMB, případně jsou připravovány a projektovány za účelem budoucího vlastnictví DPMB. Komunikace Součástí je rovněž rozsáhlé provedení celoplošné obnovy komunikačních ploch a chodníků o ploše 16 420 m2. Výstavba bude prováděna po ucelených částech. Podrobný rozsah prací na komunikačních plochách je popsán v dokladové části. Dále bude provedena rekonstrukce stávajícího světelného signalizačního zařízení (SSZ) křižovatky Úvoz – Pekařská. V rámci rekonstrukce bude také realizován mobiliář (lavičky, mříže ke stromům, odpadkové koše, zástěny na odpad, zahrazovací sloupky, stojany na kola, přístřešky MHD, pítka). Stavbu je nutné koordinovat s následujícími akcemi: • Rezidence Anenská brána (investor RUBELA, a.s.) • Reko MS Brno – Pekařská (investor GasNet, s.r.o.) • D1 - Nový laboratorní objekt (investor FNUSA) Zhotovitel je povinen zajistit: • nepřetržitý přístup a příjezd vozidel IZS do Fakultní nemocnice u sv. Anny, • průjezdnost křižovatky Úvoz x Pekařská pro veřejnou dopravu viz POV, • nepřetržitý vjezd a výjezd na pozemek p.č. 1728, k.ú. Staré Brno, • u stavebních objektů SO 452 Sdělovací kabely MU, SO 453 Sdělovací kabely VODAFONE, SO 454 Sdělovací kabely T-MOBILE, SO 455 Sdělovací kabely FASTER a SO 456 Sdělovací kabely DPMB, objednatel upozorňuje na přísné podmínky jednotlivých vlastníků sítí elektronických komunikací. Zhotovitel je povinen zajistit přeložky a zabezpečení podzemních vedení sítí elektronických komunikací tak, aby za celou dobu realizace překládky nedošlo k přerušení provozu infrastruktury, s tím, že přerušení provozu infrastruktury u každého jednotlivého přepojení kabelů infrastruktury nesmí překročit 8 hodin. Podrobný popis rozsahu požadovaných prací je uveden v projektové dokumentaci „Brno, Pekařská – rekonstrukce kanalizace a vodovodu“, vypracované společností PK OSSENDORF s.r.o. Bližší informace viz Zadávací dokumentace.

title: Pelastuslaitosten virkavaatteet
description: Pelastuslaitosten virkavaatteet Hankinnan kohteena on pelastuslaitosten virkavaatteet tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritellyn mukaisesti. Virkavaatteiden hankinta toteutetaan hankintarenkaana, jossa Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue (Pohde) vastaa valtuutettuna hankinnasta. Hankintarenkaassa on mukana 26 organisaatiosta, jotka koostuvat hyvinvointialueista, pelastuslaitoksista, Uudenmaan pelastusliitosta, Pelastusopistosta, Sisäministeriöstä, Lupa- ja valvontavirastosta sekä Finlands Svenska Brand- & Räddingsförbund:sta. Tarkka lista hankintayksiköistä löytyy hankintasopimuksesta. Pelastusviranomaisen on käytettävä virkatehtävissään pelastustoimen virkapukua, jollei virkatehtävän laatu tai luonne muuta edellytä. Pelastuslaitoksen muun henkilöstön velvollisuudesta käyttää pelastustoimen virkapukua päättää pelastuslaitos. Pelastustoimen virkapukua käytetään Pelastusopiston henkilöstön virkapukuna ja Pelastusopiston opiskelijoiden opiskelijapukuna. Pelastustoimen virkapukuun kuuluva vaatetus, asusteet ja varusteet on määritelty virkapukuasetuksessa ja tarkemmin pelastustoimen virkapuvun tuotekuvausohjeessa. Virkapuvun käyttöön liittyvä ohjeistus määritellään pelastustoimen virkapukuohjeessa. Pelastustoimen virkapukuun kuuluvat vaatteet, asusteet ja varusteet on jaettu virkapukuasetuksessa neljään asukokonaisuuteen: asemavaatetus, toimistovaatetus, vierailuvaatetus ja juhlavaatetus. Virkapukuasetuksessa määritellään, mitä merkkejä ja tunnuksia virkapukuun kuuluvissa varusteissa käytetään ja mihin ne kiinnitetään. Virkapuvussa käytetään vain asetuksessa ja ohjeessa määriteltyjä merkkejä ja tunnuksia. Virkapukujen ja tunnusten tuotekuvaukset on esitetty liitteessä 1.1 Pelastustoimen virkapuvun tuotekuvausohje 2025. Osatarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Hankinnan kohteesta poikkeavia vaihtoehtoisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. SOPIMUSKAUSI Tämän hetkisen arvion mukaan sopimus tulee voimaan maaliskuussa 2027. Sopimuskauden pituus on viisi vuotta. Sopimuskauden alussa varataan aikaa sopimuksen käyttöönotolle, joka pitää sisällään materiaalien hankinnan ja tuotteiden hyväksynnän. Sopimuksen käyttöönottoon varataan kokonaisuudessaan noin kahdeksan (8) - yhdeksän (9) kuukautta aikaa. Sopimuskauden aikana tehdään reklamaatioiden ja/tai palautteiden pohjalta tuotekehitystyötä mm. materiaalien ja mitoitusten osalta. Sopimuskauden viimeisen kuuden kuukauden aikana varastot ajetaan alas portaittain, jolloin toimitusvarmuus heikkenee. Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialue on mukana hankintarenkaassa, mutta tekee hankinnassa oman hankintapäätöksen sekä hankintasopimuksen. title: Osallistumispyyntö: Malminkartanon sydän, koulu ja kirjastokampus, projektinjohtourakoitsijan hankinta
description: Osallistumispyyntö: Malminkartanon sydän, koulu ja kirjastokampus, projektinjohtourakoitsijan hankinta Hankinnan kohteena on projektinjohtourakoitsijan hankinta Malminkartanon koulun ja kirjastokampuksen perusparannus- ja uudisrakennushankkeeseen. Hanke toteutetaan kehitysvaiheellisena yhteistoiminnallisena projektinjohtourakkana. Ennen varsinaisen projektinjohtourakkasopimuksen tekemistä valitun projektinjohtourakoitsijan kanssa toteutetaan hankkeen kehitysvaihe erillisellä kehitysvaiheen sopimuksella. Vuonna 1985 valmistuneen Puustellin monitoimitalon ja maa-alueen omistaa Helsingin kaupunki, kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Ennen urakan toteutusvaiheen käynnistämistä maa-alue vuokrataan kirjastotontin osalta Helsingin kaupungin omistamalle Keskinäinen Kiinteistö Oy Helsingin Toimitiloille ja koulutontin osalta Kiinteistö Oy Helsingin Toimitilojen omistamalle kiinteistöosakeyhtiölle. Vanha koulurakennus siirretään ennen toteutusvaiheen käynnistymistä kyseisen kiinteistöosakeyhtiön omistukseen. Puustellin monitoimitalossa tehdään laajat toiminnalliset ja tekniset perusparannukset sekä laajennus. Lisäksi Puustellin välittömään läheisyyteen, Puustellinaukion laidalle omalle tontilleen, toteutetaan kirjaston uudisrakennus. Peruskorjauksessa tilat ajanmukaistetaan opetuksen vaatimusten mukaisesti, uusitaan talotekniset asennukset ja parannetaan energiatehokkuutta. Rakenteelliset korjaukset painottuvat julkisivun riskirakenteiden eliminoimiseen ja korjaamiseen. Runko ja kantavat rakenteet säilytetään, ikkunat kunnostetaan. Vesikatto, räystäsrakenteet ja julkisivuverhous sekä lämmöneristeet uusitaan julkisivun mittasuhteet sekä rakennuksen suojelustatus huomioiden. Ulkoseinärakenteen rakennusfysikaalinen toimivuus varmistetaan. Salaojitusjärjestelmä kunnostetaan terveellisten ja turvallisten tilojen toteutumisen varmistamiseksi. Hanke käsittää koko kiinteistön kattavan teknisen ja toiminnallisen perusparannuksen. Hankkeessa uusitaan ja nykyaikaistetaan taloteknisiä järjestelmiä ja niiden konehuonetiloja sekä parannetaan energiataloutta. Hankkeessa uusitaan, korjataan ja kunnostetaan kuntotutkimuksiin ja selvityksiin perustuen rakenteita ja rakennusosia sekä vesikattoja, julkisivuja ja ikkunoita ja ovia. Sisätiloissa uusitaan ja kunnostetaan pintoja, rakennusosia ja valaisimia sekä tehdään käyttäjän toiminnan ja tilojen monikäyttöisyyden kehittämiseksi tilamuutoksia. Rakennuksen paloturvallisuutta, esteettömyyttä sekä akustiikkaa ja ääneneristystä parannetaan ja it-, av- ja esitysteknisiä valmiuksia kehitetään. Kaikessa rakennustyössä on huomioitava rakennussuojelun vaatimukset. Huonetilaohjelman laajuus on koulun osalta noin 5 166 hym² ja kirjaston osalta noin 890 hym². Kokonaislaajuus on koulun osalta noin 8 696 brm² ja kirjaston osalta noin 1 365 brm². Hankintaa koskevat sopimukset on tarkoitus tehdä siten, että tarjouskilpailulla valittavan urakoitsijan sopimuskumppaniksi kehitysvaiheessa (kehitysvaiheen sopimus) tulee Helsingin kaupunki ja urakkavaiheessa (projektinjohtourakkasopimus) sopimuskumppaniksi tulee Helsingin kaupungin omistama Kiinteistö Oy Helsingin Toimitilat tai Kiinteistö Oy Helsingin toimitilat ja sen myöhemmin nimettävä tytäryhtiö yhdessä. Helsingin kaupunki takaa kiinteistöyhtiön lainan. Alustava aikataulu: - hankintamenettely marraskuu 2026 – kesäkuu 2027 - rakentamislupahakemuksen jättäminen tammi–helmikuussa 2027 - kehitysvaiheen sopimuksen tekeminen elokuussa 2027 - rakennustöiden toteutus vuosina 2028–2030. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö, projektinjohtourakoitsijalle asetettavat vaatimukset sekä tarjousten vertailuperusteet on kuvattu hankintailmoituksessa ja sen liitteenä olevissa tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa. Liiteasiakirjat ovat saatavilla Tarjouspalvelussa kohdassa ”Liitteet ja linkit” ilmoitetun linkin kautta.,

title: Procedura aperta, ai sensi dell'art. 71 del d.lgs. n. 36/2023, articolata in un unico lotto, per l'affidamento del Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili della Sede Regionale Rai del Friuli Venezia Giulia
description: Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili della Sede Regionale Rai del Friuli Venezia Giulia, per una durata di 36 mesi con opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi (durata massima 60 mesi). La prestazione richiesta riguarda l’esercizio e la manutenzione ordinaria e a richiesta degli impianti elettrici, di climatizzazione, edili, elevatori, antincendio e di rivelazione incendi, di antintrusione e controllo accessi, di televisione a circuito chiuso (TVCC) e degli impianti TV, nonché la gestione e manutenzione delle aree verdi. Il servizio oggetto dell’affidamento prevede le seguenti prestazioni: a) manutenzione ordinaria (a canone); b) manutenzione straordinaria (su richiesta Rai); come descritto all’interno del Progetto di servizi. Informazioni e chiarimenti possono essere richiesti entro e non oltre il 04/01/2027 utilizzando l’area “Comunicazioni riservate al Concorrente”, presente nell’area di dettaglio della procedura. Le risposte alle richieste di chiarimenti sono fornite mediante pubblicazione delle richieste in forma anonima e delle relative risposte sulla Piattaforma nell’area “Comunicazioni della Stazione Appaltante”. È previsto il sopralluogo obbligatorio, da svolgersi dal 14/12/2026 al 18/12/2026 secondo termini e modalità previsti nel Disciplinare di gara. Saranno previste le seguenti fattispecie di modifica contrattuale: - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 10 del Codice sarà prevista un’opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi; pertanto, in caso di esercizio di detta opzione, la durata complessiva massima del contratto sarà pari a 60 mesi; in tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - in casi eccezionali, al verificarsi delle condizioni indicate all’art. 120 comma 11 del Codice, la durata del contratto base o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione, ancora in corso di esecuzione, potrà essere prorogata per il tempo strettamente necessario alla conclusione della procedura di individuazione del nuovo contraente. In tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - ai sensi dell’art. 120 comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, qualora l’importo contrattuale (del contratto “base” o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione) non dovesse essere esaurito alla scadenza del termine di durata contrattuale, di estendere la durata del relativo contratto per il tempo necessario a poter utilizzare l’intero importo contrattuale; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di inserire od escludere dal contratto, in tutto o in parte (a titolo esemplificativo, per un immobile, per parte dell’immobile e/o per parte degli impianti e/o dei servizi), anche per limitati periodi, insediamenti che siano acquisiti e/o ceduti ovvero entrino o escano dalla disponibilità giuridica della Stazione appaltante ovvero siano oggetto di consistenti interventi di ristrutturazione, senza diritto da parte dell’Aggiudicatario ad alcuna indennità o altra forma di riconoscimento economico, fermo restando il versamento dei corrispettivi per le prestazioni regolarmente eseguite sino alla data della modifica. A riguardo, l’Aggiudicatario prende atto ed accetta che il Servizio dovrà essere eseguito con continuità anche in caso di eventuali variazioni delle consistenze e della dislocazione delle sedi e degli immobili oggetto di manutenzione. La valutazione economica di tali modifiche/varianti avverrà facendo riferimento ai corrispettivi contrattuali. In particolare, il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza delle parti escluse/incluse e/o del periodo di esclusione dalla manutenzione, sulla base delle informazioni contenute nel Progetto di Servizi e relativi allegati; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di apportare modifiche al contratto durante il periodo di efficacia ove si verifichino scostamenti di tipo tecnologico nelle consistenze individuate all’interno della documentazione di gara, ed in tale evenienza il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza degli scostamenti verificatisi; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. d) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, in corso di esecuzione, di sostituire l’aggiudicatario iniziale con un nuovo contraente nei seguenti casi: a) risoluzione del contratto per eccessiva onerosità sopravvenuta della prestazione ai sensi del Codice civile; b) risoluzione del contratto per impossibilità sopravvenuta ai sensi del Codice civile. In tali circostanze, la sostituzione potrà interessare solo soggetti che hanno partecipato alla presente procedura alle condizioni proposte dall’operatore economico interpellato secondo le modalità di cui all’art. 124 del Codice; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 9 del Codice, in caso di variazione in aumento o in diminuzione delle prestazioni fino a concorrenza del quinto dell’importo del contratto, Rai S.p.A. potrà imporre all’appaltatore l’esecuzione alle stesse condizioni previste nel contratto originario.

title: Procedura aperta, ai sensi dell'art. 71 del d.lgs. n. 36/2023, articolata in un unico lotto, per l'affidamento del Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili della Sede Regionale Rai della Toscana
description: Global service per la gestione manutentiva degli immobili della Sede Regionale Rai della Toscana, per una durata di 36 mesi con opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi (durata massima 60 mesi). La prestazione richiesta riguarda l’esercizio e la manutenzione ordinaria e a richiesta degli impianti elettrici, di climatizzazione, edili, elevatori, antincendio e di rivelazione incendi, di antintrusione e controllo accessi, di televisione a circuito chiuso (TVCC) e degli impianti TV, nonché la gestione e manutenzione delle aree verdi. Il servizio oggetto dell’affidamento prevede le seguenti prestazioni: a) manutenzione ordinaria (a canone); b) manutenzione straordinaria (su richiesta Rai); come descritto all’interno del Progetto di servizi. Informazioni e chiarimenti possono essere richiesti entro e non oltre il 04/01/2027 utilizzando l’area “Comunicazioni riservate al Concorrente”, presente nell’area di dettaglio della procedura. Le risposte alle richieste di chiarimenti sono fornite mediante pubblicazione delle richieste in forma anonima e delle relative risposte sulla Piattaforma nell’area “Comunicazioni della Stazione Appaltante”. È previsto il sopralluogo obbligatorio, da svolgersi dal 14/12/2026 al 18/12/2026 secondo termini e modalità previsti nel Disciplinare di gara. Saranno previste le seguenti fattispecie di modifica contrattuale: - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 10 del Codice sarà prevista un’opzione di proroga della durata massima di ulteriori 24 mesi, da esercitarsi anche in via frazionata per un minimo di 6 mesi; pertanto, in caso di esercizio di detta opzione, la durata complessiva massima del contratto sarà pari a 60 mesi; in tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - in casi eccezionali, al verificarsi delle condizioni indicate all’art. 120 comma 11 del Codice, la durata del contratto base o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione, ancora in corso di esecuzione, potrà essere prorogata per il tempo strettamente necessario alla conclusione della procedura di individuazione del nuovo contraente. In tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nel contratto; - ai sensi dell’art. 120 comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, qualora l’importo contrattuale (del contratto “base” o di quello derivante dall’esercizio dell’opzione) non dovesse essere esaurito alla scadenza del termine di durata contrattuale, di estendere la durata del relativo contratto per il tempo necessario a poter utilizzare l’intero importo contrattuale; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di inserire od escludere dal contratto, in tutto o in parte (a titolo esemplificativo, per un immobile, per parte dell’immobile e/o per parte degli impianti e/o dei servizi), anche per limitati periodi, insediamenti che siano acquisiti e/o ceduti ovvero entrino o escano dalla disponibilità giuridica della Stazione appaltante ovvero siano oggetto di consistenti interventi di ristrutturazione, senza diritto da parte dell’Aggiudicatario ad alcuna indennità o altra forma di riconoscimento economico, fermo restando il versamento dei corrispettivi per le prestazioni regolarmente eseguite sino alla data della modifica. A riguardo, l’Aggiudicatario prende atto ed accetta che il Servizio dovrà essere eseguito con continuità anche in caso di eventuali variazioni delle consistenze e della dislocazione delle sedi e degli immobili oggetto di manutenzione. La valutazione economica di tali modifiche/varianti avverrà facendo riferimento ai corrispettivi contrattuali. In particolare, il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza delle parti escluse/incluse e/o del periodo di esclusione dalla manutenzione, sulla base delle informazioni contenute nel Progetto di Servizi e relativi allegati; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà di apportare modifiche al contratto durante il periodo di efficacia ove si verifichino scostamenti di tipo tecnologico nelle consistenze individuate all’interno della documentazione di gara, ed in tale evenienza il canone sarà proporzionalmente adeguato, tenuto conto della incidenza degli scostamenti verificatisi; - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. d) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva la facoltà, in corso di esecuzione, di sostituire l’aggiudicatario iniziale con un nuovo contraente nei seguenti casi: a) risoluzione del contratto per eccessiva onerosità sopravvenuta della prestazione ai sensi del Codice civile; b) risoluzione del contratto per impossibilità sopravvenuta ai sensi del Codice civile. In tali circostanze, la sostituzione potrà interessare solo soggetti che hanno partecipato alla presente procedura alle condizioni proposte dall’operatore economico interpellato secondo le modalità di cui all’art. 124 del Codice. - ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 9 del Codice, in caso di variazione in aumento o in diminuzione delle prestazioni fino a concorrenza del quinto dell’importo del contratto, Rai S.p.A. potrà imporre all’appaltatore l’esecuzione alle stesse condizioni previste nel contratto originario.

title: EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (EOI): ELDERS AND ELDER HELPERS FOR CORRECTIONAL SERVICE OF CANADA INSTITUTIONS IN THE PRAIRIES REGION
description: EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (EOI): ELDERS AND ELDER HELPERS FOR CORRECTIONAL SERVICE OF CANADA INSTITUTIONS IN THE PRAIRIES REGION PURPOSE OF THE EXPRESSION OF INTEREST The Correctional Service of Canada (CSC) is asking Elders and Elder Helpers interested in providing Indigenous cultural support and guidance to offenders to contact the CSC Representative identified below. BACKGROUND: CSC has a legal obligation to provide Indigenous offenders with programs and reintegration support that respect Indigenous culture and values. Elders and Elder Helpers provide services under contract to CSC to assist Indigenous offenders in their traditional healing journey, to develop an understanding of traditional Indigenous culture through teachings, guidance, counselling. CSC is committed to providing a variety of rehabilitation programs and opportunities to Indigenous offenders. Elders and Elder Helpers expose individuals and groups of offenders to traditional Indigenous ways of life, based on their own teachings, counselling and traditional ceremonies and practices to promote ongoing healing and balance, and increase the likelihood of successful reintegration. CSC relies on support from First Nation communities, Metis communities, Inuit communities and Indigenous organizations to provide cultural immersion and practices to Indigenous offenders that CSC cannot offer or manage. The Canadian Federal Correctional environment presents challenges in trying to offer Indigenous support and services within institutions due to the constraints of various security levels, the related level of controlled movement of offenders, and other security requirements. CSC has developed policy and guidelines to better support cultural practices and ceremonies. REQUIREMENTS: CSC respects the cultural and traditions of Indigenous communities and strives to treat Elders and Elder Helpers with the utmost respect. Any Elder or Elder Helper interested in providing services to indigenous offenders must be recognized by their Indigenous community as having the knowledge and understanding of the community’s traditional culture, including their ceremonies, protocols, teachings and healing practices, according to their beliefs and social traditions. Knowledge and wisdom are the essential and defining traits Elders and Elder Helpers achieve by following a traditional way of life consistent with the teachings of their community’s Elders and healers over a significant period. Elders and Elder Helpers must be recognized as such by Indigenous communities, other Elders and their teachers. The tasks Elders within CSC typically perform include counselling, teachings, ceremonies and activities for individuals and groups such as: - Providing guidance and teachings through group sessions (circles) and individual discussions with offenders in the institution. - Conducting spiritual services and various traditional ceremonies based on each Elder’s teachings. - Assisting offenders following a healing path in support of their correctional plan. - Escorting offenders on Escorted Temporary Absences (ETAs) for ceremonial and other spiritual purposes as requested and mutually agreed upon. - Providing advice and information to staff and management, locally, regionally and nationally on issues of Indigenous spirituality, cultural practices, ceremonies, ceremonial objects, traditional practices and protocols, traditional medicine or sacred grounds within the institution. This includes the collection and storage of ceremonial objects and traditional and ceremonial medicines. - Introducing institutional staff to various elements of traditional spirituality as deemed appropriate based on the Elder’s teachings. - Participating in case conferences as requested and providing verbal comments to the offender’s Case Management Team regarding the offender’s participation in a healing path and cultural involvement. Elder Helpers within CSC support and assist Elders to facilitate delivery of services and provide support, such as: - Ensuring offenders and staff follow appropriate protocols when approaching the Elder - Ensuring there are adequate supplies of traditional and ceremonial items, materials and medicines for ceremony purposes as requested by the Elder - Coordinating and providing supervision of offenders during ceremonies and assistance at the Elder’s request. Providing performance of ceremonies in the Elder’s absence. This also includes scheduling of ceremonies and providing notification of participants to Elders and staff as required. - Conducting group discussions and teachings, with the Elder’s agreement, in the identification and proper use of ceremonial objects to offenders and staff. - Assisting the Elder in preparing written and verbal reports to support case management teams and participating in staff meetings. - Providing counselling services as directed when the Elder is unavailable. - Providing cultural awareness sessions to staff to promote a culturally safe environment. CONSTRAINTS: Characteristics of the offender population: Along with recognizing the gender, cultural, religious and linguistic differences of inmates, Elders and Elder Helpers must particularly take into consideration the historical context of the lives of Canada’s Indigenous peoples and be sensitive to the impacts of intergenerational trauma and the physical, mental, emotional, and social harms experienced by Indigenous people. Security: As Elders or Elder Helpers under contract to CSC have access to protected information and provide cultural support and guidance within correctional facilities, they are subject to security requirements. They must take measures to protect shared personal and protected information in accordance with the contract’s security requirements. Insurance: Elder and Elder Helpers must comply with CSC’s insurance requirements including Commercial General Liability Insurance and maintain it through the duration of the contract. SUPPORT TO CONTRACTOR: To support Elders and Elder Helpers in providing services to Indigenous Offenders, CSC provides the following: 1. Appropriately equipped facilities for the provision of confidential spiritual services, including the designation of (private) indoor and outdoor space to conduct traditional ceremonies, spiritual activities, and one on one counselling. 2. Ensuring financial and human resources are provided for the gathering of ceremonial objects outside the institution. 3. Ensuring Indigenous Liaison Officers or Parole Officers are available to assist Elders and Elder Helpers in documenting verbal reports Elders and Elder Helpers provide and ensuring the completion of Elder Reviews as per the outline in Commissioner Directive 702 (i.e. Intake, Progress and Decision). 4. Providing orientation to the institution, including all policies and security requirements Elders and Elder Helpers have to follow when carrying out their tasks. 5. Ensuring Elders Elder Helpers are paired with offenders with the same language requirements (French or English). ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS Elders and Elder Helpers providing services to CSC offenders must meet the following essential requirements. CSC reserves the right to modify any and all of these requirements at any time in accordance with its needs. 1. The Elder or Elder Helper must be recognized by their community as an Elder/Elder Helper/Cultural Advisor within that community. 2. The Elder or Elder Helper must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience obtained in the past 10 years in delivering spiritual and cultural services and teachings to Indigenous people. This experience must include: a) providing counselling and guidance according to the traditions and teachings of their own community; and b) being familiar with and able to conduct a variety of ceremonies with a focus on healing according to their own teachings. 3. title: Fire Alarm BPA Fort Drum NY
description: This synopsis is for informational purposes only. This is not a request for quote and no solicitation exists. The Mission & Installation Contracting Command (MICC), Fort Drum, NY is seeking multiple businesses willing to enter into a Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) for services under North American Industry Classification System Code (NAICS) 561321: Security Systems Services index Fire alarm sales combined with installation, repair, or monitoring services. The small business size standard for this industry is $22.0 million in average annual revenue. Fire Alarm projects would include but are not limited to the following: providing all necessary resources, management, personnel, materials, transportation, supplies, and equipment, except Government Furnished Property (GFP), necessary in repairing, replacing, and reprogramming of fire alarm systems, sprinkler system, security systems, facility access control systems and all associated equipment in facilities on Fort Drum, NY. Insurance is required for these types of projects; a current certification of insurance must be provided prior to receiving a BPA. Some BPA calls may be posted to UNISON, while not required it is encouraged for vendors receiving a BPA to register at UNISON. Registration is free and can be completed at https://www.unisonglobal.com/product-suites/acquisition/marketplace/ Generally some calls placed will be below $25,000, and may be sporadic in nature. The Contractor must be able to accept the Government Purchase Card (GPC) and submit invoices in Wide Area Workflow (WAWF). To register and access WAWF, go to https://wawf.eb.mil/. BPAs will be evaluated annually and may remain in place for up to five years. IAW FAR 52.204-7 interested parties must be registered with the System for Award Management Registration (SAM) under NACIS code 561621. The registrations can be done through System for Award Management (SAM) for free at https://www.sam.gov The Contractor will not receive a BPA until these registrations are completed. Any interested party should submit their DUNS number, CAGE Code, and Tax ID number to SFC Timmons at david.b.timmons.mil@army.mil. Any correspondence relating to this synopsis should have FIRE ALARM BPA notated in the subject field.

title: Navy Electronic Chart Display and Information System (ECDIS) Hardware and Software Production
description: Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Mission Systems is issuing a Full and Open Competitive Solicitation (N00024-26-R-5246) for the development, production, integration, testing, fielding, and lifecycle sustainment of the U.S. Navy Electronic Chart Display and Information System (ECDIS) Hardware and Software. This procurement supports PAE Mission Systems structure, the acronym �PMW/A� means Program Manager, Warfighting / Applications (PMW/A 520) Navigation Program requirements for both surface and subsurface platforms. The resultant contract will provide continued production and sustainment of Navy ECDIS Hardware and Software. Hardware Scope: Includes production, sustainment, integration, assembly, and testing. Software Scope: Includes maintenance, modification, upgrades, integration, testing, and delivery of ECDIS software products. These software scope activities will be provided as level-of-effort tasks under Government oversight, with technical support from the Navy ECDIS Systems Engineering and Integration Agent, NSWC Philadelphia, PA. Award is anticipated in Q4 FY27 and will be made to the Offeror whose proposal represents the Best Value to the Government in accordance with FAR 15.101?1. The planned contract structure includes one base year with four one?year option periods, beginning in FY27. Deliveries are anticipated to be FOB Destination.

title: Germany – Trousers – Lieferung von Einsatzbekleidung SEK/MEK
description: Dem LZN obliegt die Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen für die unmittelbare niedersächsische Landesverwaltung (vgl. § 2 der Betriebsanweisung des LZN). Mit Zustimmung seiner Aufsichtsbehörde kann das LZN weitere Aufgaben für öffentlich-rechtliche Bedarfsträger innerhalb und außerhalb der niedersächsischen Landesverwaltung sowie für privatrechtliche Gesellschaften in vollständiger Eigentümerschaft der öffentlichen Hand übernehmen (vgl. § 3 Betriebsanweisung). In dieser Zuständigkeit umfasst der Auftrag den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit einem Unternehmen (§ 21 VgV) über die Lieferung von Einsatzbekleidung SEK/MEK für Kooperation der Polizei der norddeutschen Küstenländer und die Kunden des LZN gem. beigefügter Auftraggeberliste. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind den technischen Lieferbedingungen und dem Angebotsvordruck zu entnehmen.

buyer: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
title: Sweden – Health services – OHD/260934 Support to a point prevalence survey of healthcare-associated infections and antimicrobial use in long-term care facilities, including data validation and analysis
description: Framework contract for scientific, technical and project-management support to ECDC for a multi-year, cross-sectional point prevalence survey (PPS) of healthcare-associated infections (HAIs), antimicrobial use and infection prevention and control / antimicrobial stewardship structure and process indicators in long-term care facilities (LTCFs) in EU/EEA countries. The services will build on the previous HALT/LTCF PPS approach including: preparation and organisation of the PPS; development/adaptation of training materials, case studies, feedback-report templates and data-collection questionnaires; support to national PPS preparation and training; helpdesk, methodological and technical support to national contact points; support to data collection and data-quality checks; production of validated national databases; country- and LTCF-level feedback reports; analysis plans; early and final European survey reports; presentations/minutes for meetings; and related dissemination outputs including open-access fees for manuscripts. The contract also includes validation and additional analytical work to assess whether HAIs reported in LTCFs are correctly reported according to agreed case definitions, whether infections can be assessed as associated with healthcare in the LTCF context, and the impact of potential misclassification on PPS estimates. This may include protocol development for validation sub-studies, training and standardisation of validators, review of source documentation where available, inter-rater agreement analyses, sensitivity analyses, and methodological recommendations for future European LTCF PPS.

title: National Framework Agreement for the provision of Sexual Health Services
description: The demand for accessible, high-quality and innovative sexual health services continues to evolve in response to changing population needs, advances in clinical practice, increasing digital delivery models and the ongoing focus on reducing health inequalities. The Framework will provide Relevant Authorities with a fully compliant route for the provision of sexual health services, supporting the commissioning of integrated, digital, clinical, diagnostic, prevention, outreach and specialist support services. The Framework is designed to enable Contracting Authorities to secure services that improve public health outcomes, promote early intervention and prevention, support vulnerable populations, and ensure equitable access to care. The overall aim of the Framework is to provide a compliant route to market facilitating the procurement of various Sexual Health Services. The Framework has been established under The Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023 and The Health Services (Provider Selection Regime) (Wales) Regulations 2025 (and as amended) (together the PSR) for use by all Relevant Authorities (and any future successors to these organisations). "Relevant Authority" is defined in section 12ZB(7) of the National Health Service Act 2006 and in section 10A(9) of the National Health Service (Wales) Act 2006. It means a combined authority, an integrated care board, a local authority in England, NHS England, an NHS foundation trust or an NHS trust established under section 25 of the National Health Service Act 2006, a county council or county borough council in Wales, a local health board established under section 11 of the National Health Service (Wales) Act 2006, a National Health Service trust established under section 18 of the National Health Service (Wales) Act 2006, or a special health authority established under section 22 of the National Health Service (Wales) Act 2006. For the avoidance of doubt, any successor bodies of any of the above entities shall be entitled to place Orders and shall be deemed Relevant Authorities for the purposes of this Framework. The Framework will be re-opened to new applicants every two years, approximately 90 days before the anniversary of the Framework Commencement Date.

Controlled by: DEPARTMENT OF THE NAVY Controlled by: NAVAIR CUI Category: General Procurement and Acquisition and Source Selection Distribution/Dissemination Control: FEDCON POC: PCO, faith.l.lagore.civ@us.navy.mil Sources Sought RFI Synopsis: Labor-Only Fire Alarm System Support Services THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. The responses to this sources sought will be utilized to determine if the Government will determine what the vendor capability and the potential cost of the services requested. The Product Service Code (PSC) for this requirement is J063. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 561621. SCOPE OF WORK: Labor-Only Fire Alarm System Support Services 1. Purpose Provide labor-only technical support for the maintenance, programming, troubleshooting, repair, modification, testing, and commissioning of Fire Alarm Systems (FAS) installed at NAWS China Lake. Parts shall be furnished by the Government after receiving itemized quote from the Contractor. The Government will not provide tools, test equipment, computers, software, or any other materials required to perform the work. 2. Quantity of Services The contract will include a maximum of thirty (30) on-site service calls during the period of performance. Up to three (3) of these calls may be designated as emergency service calls requiring a response time of 24 hours or less. All other service calls shall require a response within 72 hours. Additional service calls may be ordered at the same unit price as needed. 3. Definition of a Service Call A service call consists of one on-site visit by the Contractor to perform up to eight (8) hours of productive work. Travel time is excluded and will not be paid. The Government will prioritize and bundle multiple work requests into single service calls whenever practical. 4. Contractor Qualifications All technicians performing work under this contract shall hold current NICET Level II or higher certification in Fire Alarm Systems. The Contractor must be factory-authorized and possess all required proprietary software, programming tools, licenses, dongles, and access rights for the full range of fire alarm systems currently installed at NAWS China Lake (including legacy systems). Systems include but are not limited to: Edwards (EST), Fike, Potter, Bosch/Radionics, Honeywell, Siemens (Cerberus), Mircom, Gamewell-FCI, Notifier, Simplex, Kidde, Monaco Enterprises, Fire-Lite, and Autocall. 5. Scope of Services Examples of services to be provided upon request by the Government include but are not limited to: Troubleshooting, programming changes, and system modifications Commissioning and retro-commissioning of fire alarm systems 100% zone testing coordinated with the Regional Dispatch Center (RDC) Account activations with RDC Completion and updating of R9 forms with RDC Technical telephone support during normal business hours Repair and restoration of systems to normal operating condition Modifying, correcting, or replacing obsolete systems. Software and hardware technical assistance 6. Reporting Requirements For each service call, the Contractor shall provide a detailed Field Service Report that includes, at a minimum: Service Call Number Date(s) of service Invoice Number Navy Point of Contact Technician name(s) Building number(s) Description of work requested by the Navy Detailed description of actions taken and resolution Relevant tracking notes (delays, cancellations, parts required, etc.) If a service call is not fully resolved during the visit, the report must also include: Reason the repair was not performed Remaining actions required to complete the repair (including specific parts needed) Estimated additional labor hours and projected completion date 7. Invoicing Invoices shall be submitted for each completed service call and shall reference the service call number. Each invoice must be accompanied by the corresponding Field Service Report. Classified material SHALL NOT be submitted. All proprietary or corporate data received shall be clearly identified and will be protected from release to sources outside the Government.? Any resulting contract is anticipated to have a security classification level of unclassified at time of contract award for personnel and facilities clearances. Your response to this Sources Sought, including any capabilities statement, must be electronically submitted in either Microsoft Word or searchable Portable Document Format (PDF) via email to the Contracting Officer, ?Faith La Gore at faith.l.lagore.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 4 pm PST on January 13th, 2027 and reference �Labor-Only Fire Alarm System Support Services Sources Sought�. Past Performance: Up to 3 examples of similar projects performed within the last 3 to 5 years (including contract numbers, agency, and brief scope). Rough order of Magnitude with estimated costs of this service. Responses to this request may not be returned. The Government is under no obligation to consider information received after the required due date as part of the formal market research for this acquisition. All data received in response to this Sources Sought that is marked or designated as corporate or proprietary will be fully protected from any release outside the Government. description: Obiectul prezentului contract constă în execuția lucrărilor pentru realizarea obiectivului de investiție: „Mărirea capacității educaționale prin extinderea unității de învățământ a <<Liceului Dimitirie Cantemir>>, amenajare exterioară, sistematizare verticală, amenajare pistă de alergare și spații activități sportive în aer liber”, în conformitate cu prevederile Proiectului Tehnic (PTh), ale Detaliilor de Execuție (DDE) și ale Caietului de Sarcini. Realizarea obiectivului conduce la îmbunătățirea infrastructurii educaționale, oferind elevilor un spațiu modern și adecvat pentru desfășurarea activităților educaționale. Prin această investiție, se urmărește nu doar dezvoltarea tinerilor, ci și crearea unui mediu educațional complet, adaptat nevoilor actuale și orientat spre performanță și bunăstare. Proiectul propune extinderea spațiului construit al școlii actuale cu încă două volume: un volum de legătură P+1E cu dublă orientare N-E/S-V și un volum S+P+2E cu dublă orientare spre N-V/S-E. Amplasamentul pe care se va realiza obiectivul de investiții se află în intravilanul municipiului Iași, județul Iași. Prin realizarea acestui obiectiv, se face un pas important în direcția promovării unui stil de viață activ și echilibrat în rândul tinerilor, dar și în sprijinirea educației prin mijloace moderne. Investiția reflectă angajamentul autorităților locale de a susține performanța educațională și dezvoltarea personală într-un cadru care încurajează învățarea, colaborarea și implicarea civică. Proiectul propus contribuie la îmbunătățirea infrastructurii educaționale, oferind elevilor un spațiu modern și adecvat pentru desfășurarea activităților educaționale. Prin această investiție, se urmărește nu doar dezvoltarea tinerilor, ci și crearea unui mediu educațional complet, adaptat nevoilor actuale și orientat spre performanță și bunăstare.Valoarea estimată a contractului: 35.862.026,48 lei fără TVA se defalca astfel: Amenajarea terenului-8.024,91lei fara TVA,Amenajari pentru protectia mediului si aducerea la starea initiala-155.000,00lei fara TVA,Cheltuieli pentru asigurarea utilitatilor necesare obiectivului de investitii-50.000,00lei fara TVA,Constructii si instalatii-33.761.097,87 lei fara TVA,Montaj utilaje tehnologice-175.302,70,Utilaje,echipamente tehnologice si functionale care necesita montaj-1.647.601,00lei fara TVA,Lucrari de constructii si instalatii aferente organizarii de santier-50.000,00lei fara TVA.Cheltuieli conexe organizarii de santier-15.000,00 lei fara TVA.Valoarea cheltuielilor diverse și neprevăzute, precizată în devizul general (cap. 5.3) este de 548.456,96 lei fără TVA și nu este inclusă în valoarea estimată, aceasta putând fi accesate, după caz, în funcție de necesități, prin modificarea contractului în condițiile prevăzute la art.221 din Legea nr.98/2016 Termenul limită în care Autoritatea contractanta va răspunde în mod clar și complet tuturor solicitărilor de clarificări: 11 zile înainte de termenul stabilit pentru depunerea ofertelor în anunțul de participare . title: Objektplanung - BBS I, Umsetzung Brandschutzkonzept
description: Die Stadt Delmenhorst hat aufgrund von festgestellten Mängeln bei einer Brandschutzbegehung ein Brandschutzkonzept in Auftrag gegeben. Dieses soll nun bauordnungsrechtlich genehmigt werden und die darin beschriebenen Brandschutzmaßnahmen geplant und umgesetzt werden. Für die Planung der technischen Anlagen in den Gebäuden (Brandwarnanlage, Hausalarmierungsanlage, Sicherheitsstromversorgung, Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlagen und elektrische Leitungsanlagen) wird ein Fachplaner hinzugezogen. Für die erforderlichen Maßnahmen wurde im Rahmen des Brandschutzkonzeptes eine Priorisierungsliste erstellt. Die Hauptmaßnahmen hieraus sind die Errichtung von zwei notwendigen Außentreppen als bauliche 2. Flucht- und Rettungswege, die Ertüchtigung der Hausalarmierungsanlage des Hauptgebäudes auf eine Brandwarnanlage mit Sicherheitsstromversorgung, der Einbau einer Hausalarmierungsanlage im Nebengebäude, Einbau von Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlagen mit Sicherheitsstromversorgung, Ausführung elektrischer Leitungsanlagen mit Funktionserhalt, Herstellung einer Rauchableitung mit Auslösestellen in einem Treppenraum, Herstellen einer Rauchableitung für den Aufzugschacht im Dach und weitere diverse Brandschutzmaßnahmen, wie z.B. der Austausch von Türen und Verglasungen mit brandschutztechnischer Anforderung oder ein Verschließen ehemaliger Türöffnungen. In bestimmten Bereichen sind Bauteile auf ihre Brandschutzqualität zu überprüfen und ggf. zu ertüchtigen oder in geforderter Qualität zu errichten, dies betrifft insbesondere Leitungsdurchführungen und deren Schottung, Installationsschächte, Entlüftungseinrichtungen innenliegender Bäder und Anschlusspunkte im Bereich der Dächer.
